summary: Hybrid wavetable synth: three engine slots, each a morphing wavetable or an analog oscillator with 1–16 unison voices and two warps (bend, sync, FM, PM, AM, ring and more), a sub and a noise, two filters per note (ladder, state-variable, comb; serial to parallel), oversampled 2× or 4×; two modulation envelopes, four LFOs (built-in or drawn shapes), four macros and sixteen routes. Use it for wide unison leads, evolving pads, FM and sync basses, plucks and bells.

imports.description: A WAV wavetable: frames of 2048 samples (or a clm chunk saying the frame size), or one short single cycle. Becomes a slot's "User" table: item 0 is slot A, 1 slot B, 2 slot C.

A drawn LFO shape: a text file of breakpoints "phase,value[,curve]" separated by spaces (phase 0–1 across one cycle, value −1–1, curve −1–1: 0 straight, below 0 a fast start, above a slow one; a point at 0 and one at 1 make a jump at the wrap). item 0–3 picks LFO 1–4; its shape is set to Drawn.
